title: Cellular Architecture and Osmoregulation in Trypanosoma cruzi: Bridging Structure and Function with Cryo-ET
content: Trypanosoma cruzi, the causative agent of Chagas disease, relies on sophisticated osmoregulatory mechanisms to survive diverse environmental conditions across its life cycle. Central to this system are the contractile vacuole complex (CVC) and acidocalcisomes (Acc).
